'''Haig Halen''' is the Curator of the [[Varrock Museum]]. He can be found on the ground floor. When asked about treasure, he'll tell the player that the museum is "full of treasures" and that anything the museum found took some time to acquire. You can trade him 250 cut [[Ruby|rubies]], 100 [[cosmic rune]]s, 500 [[fire rune]]s and a [[Digsite pendant]] for a [[curator's medallion]].

You may speak to him after gaining 50 [[Kudos]] to complete an [[Varrock Diary#Easy|easy achievement diary task]]. He is also overseeing the construction of the [[Canal barge|barge]], which requires 100 [[Kudos]] to [[Bone Voyage|assist with]].

[[Kudos#Salvaging_relics|Relics]] obtained from [[shipwreck salvaging]] can be given to him in exchange for 1 Kudos and an [[antique lamp (salvaging)|antique lamp]]. After turning in all eight relics, he will start saying various lines similar to those found inscribed on the relics, though it is unclear if he is being possessed by something, or if the player is hallucinating what he is saying, as he does not remember saying anything unusual himself.
